svg.title: Moist convection and precipitation: computational flow
svg.desc: One moist-physics step: build the predictor state, share one saturation specific humidity, run Kuo-type convection closed by the moisture supply (deep convection, shallow convection or none), apply dry convective adjustment and large-scale condensation, let precipitation fall through the layers with phase change and re-evaporation, diagnose convective and stratiform cloud cover and cloud liquid water, and return tendencies, surface precipitation and cloud fields to the model.
svg.text: Kuo-type convection: cloud intensity closed by the moisture supply
tendencies act from the lift level to the cloud top
vertical diffusion acts inside the shallow cloud
Unstable layers are mixed to a
repeats until the column is stable
Fallout through the layers: phase change and re-evaporation
Lowest-layer outflow → surface rain and snow:
Cloud diagnosis: rain intensity and relative humidity
Random overlap gives the total cover
Cloud liquid water comes from height decay and column
moisture; it serves radiation, not the rain reservoir
